To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the EM algorithm is a good method for dealing with item score missingness in multidimensional polytomously scored item data when factor analysis is done.

EM and listwise deletion are the best missingness methods for the analysis of multidimensional rating scale item data, and that imputation of the mean across available scores is the best alternative to listwise deletion.

the factor loadings structure obtained with EM is the best approximation of the structure obtained from the data matrix with complete data, and that the best alternative to using EM is the imputation of the mean of the available scores for a person.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of item score missingness in multidimensional rating scale data and the effects of missingness on factor analysis.
the effects of missingness on factor analysis of multidimensional data.
the effect of item score nonresponse on the factor loadings structure in multidimensional rating scale data.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the EM algorithm is a powerful and useful tool for dealing with missing data in multidimensional polytomies, and it should be used whenever possible.
EM is a very good method for dealing with the problem of item missingness in multidimensional rating scale data.
the EM algorithm should be applied to the analysis of multidimensional rating scale data suffering from ignorably missing item responses.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
EM is the best method to use for the imputation of item scores when factor analysis is done.
EM is the method of choice to handle the problem of missing data in multidimensional item score data.
the EM algorithm is the best method to deal with the missing data in the multidimensional item response data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
missingness in item scores does not affect the structure of the factors.
EM and imputation are better alternatives to listwise deletion.
the factor loadings structure is not affected when the item score missing mechanism is MCAR or MAR.
